cat << 'EOF' > test_ast.py
import ast

def validate_expr(expr_str):
    try:
        node = ast.parse(expr_str, mode='eval').body
    except SyntaxError:
        return False

    allowed_types = (
        ast.Expression,
        ast.BoolOp,
        ast.BinOp,
        ast.UnaryOp,
        ast.Compare,
        ast.Constant,
        ast.Name,
        ast.And,
        ast.Or,
        ast.Not,
        ast.Eq,
        ast.NotEq,
        ast.Lt,
        ast.LtE,
        ast.Gt,
        ast.GtE,
        ast.Load
    )
    
    def check_node(n):
        if not isinstance(n, allowed_types):
            return False
        
        # Additional check to only allow specific names (fields)
        if isinstance(n, ast.Name):
            if n.id not in ['id', 'name', 'email']:
                return False
        
        # Check children
        for field, value in ast.iter_fields(n):
            if isinstance(value, list):
                for item in value:
                    if isinstance(item, ast.AST) and not check_node(item):
                        return False
            elif isinstance(value, ast.AST):
                if not check_node(value):
                    return False
        return True

    return check_node(node)

# Test cases
print(validate_expr("name == 'Ada'"))  # True
print(validate_expr("id > 1 and email != 'x@y.org'"))  # True
print(validate_expr("foo()"))  # False
print(validate_expr("user.name"))  # False
EOF
python3 test_ast.py
